subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Now that current main already returns native subagent completions to the requester agent, should OpenClaw also expose a per-spawn strict internal-only mode that forces `deliver:false` and never falls back to external delivery?
rationale: The remaining branch behavior is no longer required to make orchestration possible; it is a new fail-closed delivery policy, model-facing API, and persisted session-state contract whose value and failure semantics require maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep one completion path
options.body: Close or withdraw this PR because current main already provides parent-first orchestration without another model-facing routing policy or persisted field.

options.title: Sponsor strict internal-only mode
options.body: Retarget the PR against current main and explicitly document why forced `deliver:false` is needed beyond the existing parent-owned response and `NO_REPLY` behavior.

options.title: Accept the proposed contract
options.body: Approve the per-spawn option, nullable SQLite state, restart replay, and no-channel-fallback failure mode as permanent supported behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep one completion path
recommendation.body: Close or withdraw this PR because current main already provides parent-first orchestration without another model-facing routing policy or persisted field.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work covers the current sessions-spawn and completion-handoff behavior, making them the best available owner for choosing whether a second public routing mode should exist.
